prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one original square 1024x1024 World of Warcraft addon project icon for Mealbook, a chef's cookbook that grows as the player learns cooking recipes.
Primary request: A thick OPEN cookbook with warm copper-brown leather covers, chunky burnished copper and golden corner fittings, thick warm cream parchment pages, and a single stout wooden cooking spoon resting diagonally over the right-hand page, with its broad deep bowl and substantial handle clearly readable. The left page bears one large simple hand-inked drawing of a round cooking pot with two broad curling strokes of steam. Sparse abstract short pen strokes suggest recipe notes but NO actual writing, letters or readable text. A muted rust-red ribbon bookmark hangs below the central spine. The open book is the main large shape and the spoon is the clear secondary shape, both centred in a three-quarter top-down view, filling about 85 percent of the square with all edges visible. The spoon is visibly wood, not a feather, sword or magic wand. Inviting, well-used kitchen object with a few subtle stains, generous broad shapes, not a still life full of ingredients.
Style: Match a cohesive existing family of World of Warcraft inventory icons: vivid hand-painted fantasy illustration, bold angular brushwork visible across leather, metal and parchment, chunky exaggerated forms, thick faceted copper-gold bevels, bright sculpted yellow-gold highlights, deep burnt-orange shadows, rich jewel-tone contrast and a very restrained cool teal rim light. This should look like the same illustrator who painted a magical parchment-and-turquoise tome, a chunky golden keyring and a gold-rimmed blue steel shield. Copper and warm parchment give the cookbook its own identity. Rich painted game-item art, never a smooth realistic product render. Strong silhouette readable at 32–64 pixels, few large forms, no tiny ornament.
Backdrop: opaque full-bleed deep inky midnight-navy square with subtle blue painterly vignette and quiet near-black corners, matching the sibling addon icons.
Constraints: ONLY one finished icon. No text, letters, typography, wordmark, watermark, outer frame, rounded app tile, logo sheet, screenshot, mockup, photorealism, flat vector art, glossy 3D render, characters, faces, chef hats, hands, faction crests, scattered ingredients, floating food, separate bowls or pots outside the book, quills, floating magical stars, green checkmark, tiny sparkles or excessive magical aura.
